title: Independent periodic band-gap test of halogenated pyridinium lead bromides
difficulty_reasons: Three heavy-element periodic crystals require independent method and relativistic-treatment choices.
The agent must validate band gaps and band-edge character for each object and test a qualitative structure–gap hypothesis.

data.description: Supplied immutable CCDC 2499860/2499862/2499861 CIFs for the Cl/Br/I 300 K P21/c crystals; database retrieval is not scored.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable per-crystal validated gaps, band-edge evidence, structural comparison, conclusion and limitations.
